steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Odoo with username 'admin' and password 'admin' and submit the login form. Then navigate to the Sales app (or Sales > Customers) and create a new customer with name exactly '{{runid}} Bench Customer' and City field set to 'Benchville'. Save the record. Verify the customer record is saved and report the customer name and city shown on the saved record. Note: Odoo long-polls so never wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state instead.

02-create: In the Odoo Sales app, create a new quotation (Sales > Orders > Quotations, click New). In the Customer field, type '{{runid}} Bench Customer' and select the matching option from the autocomplete dropdown (it must actually be chosen from the dropdown, not just typed). Then add exactly ONE order line: in the product column of the first order line, click the product field and pick any product from the product catalogue via the autocomplete dropdown (it must actually be chosen from the dropdown). Set that line's quantity to 3. Do NOT add any second line yet. Read and report: (a) the exact product name you chose, (b) the unit price the app automatically filled in for that line, and (c) the Untaxed Amount the app computes at the bottom of the order. Do not confirm or save-as-anything other than leaving it as a draft quotation. Note: Odoo long-polls so never wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state instead.

03-open: Open the existing draft quotation {{02-create.order_reference}} in the Odoo Sales app (Sales > Orders > Quotations, find the row/record named {{02-create.order_reference}} for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' and open it). It currently has ONE order line: product '{{02-create.product_name}}', quantity 3. Add a SECOND order line with a DIFFERENT product: click 'Add a product' on the second (new) line, and pick a different product from the product catalogue via the autocomplete dropdown (it must actually be chosen from the dropdown, and it must not be Acoustic Bloc Screens). Set that second line's quantity to 2. Do not change the first line. Save the quotation (keep it a draft, do not confirm). Read and report: (a) the exact product name of the second line, (b) its unit price, and (c) the new Untaxed Amount the app computes at the bottom of the order. Note: Odoo long-polls so never wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state instead.

04-open: Open the existing draft quotation {{02-create.order_reference}} in the Odoo Sales app (Sales > Orders > Quotations, open the record named {{02-create.order_reference}} for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer'). It has two order lines: line 1 is product '{{02-create.product_name}}' with quantity {{02-create.quantity}} and unit price {{02-create.unit_price}}; line 2 is product '{{03-open.second_product_name}}' with quantity {{03-open.second_line_quantity}} and unit price {{03-open.second_line_unit_price}}. Change ONLY the first line's quantity from 3 to 5 (leave the second line and all prices untouched). Save the quotation (keep it a draft, do not confirm). Read and report from the page: (a) the first line's quantity now shown, (b) the first line's subtotal, and (c) the new Untaxed Amount the app computes at the bottom of the order. Note: Odoo long-polls so never wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state instead.
